name: Cevimeline Hydrochloride
indications_original: Cevimeline is indicated for the treatment of symptoms of dry mouth in patients with Sjögren’s Syndrome.
contraindications_original: The recommended dose of Cevimeline Hydrochloride is 30 mg taken three times a day. There is insufficient safety information to support doses greater than 30 mg tid. There is also insufficient evidence for additional efficacy of Cevimeline Hydrochloride at doses greater than 30 mg tid.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Cevimeline Hydrochloride Capsules, 30 mg are available as white, hard gelatin capsules containing 30 mg of Cevimeline Hydrochloride. Cevimeline Hydrochloride Capsules are size 3 hard gelatin capsules with an opaque white cap and body. Cevimeline Hydrochloride capsules are imprinted with P 657 on both cap and body in black ink. Cevimeline Hydrochloride is supplied in child resistant bottles of:
                  Bottles of 30: NDC 87063-180-30 (repackaged from NDC 16571-657-XX)
                  Bottles of 60: NDC 87063-180-60 (repackaged from NDC 16571-657-XX)
                  Bottles of 90: NDC 87063-180-90 (repackaged from NDC 16571-657-XX)
                  Bottles of 100: NDC 87063-180-01 (relabeled from NDC 16571-657-10)
                  
                  Store at 25°C (77°F) excursions permitted to 15°-30°C (59°-86°F) 
    [See USP Controlled Room Temperature].
 
                  Rx only
                  
                     Relabeled and Repackaged by:
                  
                  Enovachem PHARMACEUTICALS
                  Torrance, CA 90501
adverseReactions_original: Cevimeline is contraindicated in patients with uncontrolled asthma, known hypersensitivity to cevimeline, and when miosis is undesirable, e.g., in acute iritis and in narrow-angle (angle-closure) glaucoma.
